fullbrightutils.screen.title: FullbrightUtils
fullbrightutils.tooltip.gamma_boost: Uniformly brightens the whole scene. At 0 your vanilla gamma is used; higher values override it beyond the vanilla maximum.
fullbrightutils.tooltip.night_vision: Lifts only dark areas, like the night vision potion — already-lit areas stay unchanged. Higher values brighten darker spots more.
fullbrightutils.tooltip.darkness_scale: Reduces how strongly the Darkness effect dims your view. Off = full darkness applies.
fullbrightutils.tooltip.blindness_scale: Reduces how strongly the Blindness effect fogs your view. Off = full blindness applies.
fullbrightutils.tooltip.nether_fog: Reduces the thick atmospheric fog in the Nether. Off = vanilla fog; 100% = fog fully removed.
fullbrightutils.tooltip.dark_pulse: Controls whether the Darkness effect pulses. On = natural oscillation between light and dark; Off = vision locked at the darkest point.
